topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I found old items stashed away in the attic—boxes and trunks crammed with memories that aren’t mine. Photographs, toys, even letters tied with faded ribbons. I could easily pretend I didn't notice, but that doesn’t feel right. Each piece whispers stories of the past, and I’m tempted to uncover them. Yet, I can’t shake the thought that these belong to someone, that they might be looking for these remnants of their lives. I should contact the previous owners, offer to return what I’ve uncovered. It’s the least I can do, even if it means disrupting their peace.
